Worker1.subtask: Build the west half of the foundation using cobblestone. Place a solid 5x8 foundation layer from X=242 to X=246, Z=-502 to Z=-495, at Y=-60.

You are Worker1, positioned at X=244, Y=-60, Z=-498. Do NOT move or navigate. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 1 of 4: FOUNDATION (West Half)

Your task: Build a solid cobblestone foundation for the west half of the house.

COORDINATES:
- X range: 242 to 246 (5 blocks wide)
- Z range: -502 to -495 (8 blocks deep)
- Y level: -60 (foundation layer)

BUILD INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Place cobblestone blocks in a solid 5x8 rectangle
2. Start at corner X=242, Z=-502, Y=-60
3. Fill all 40 positions (5 x 8 = 40 cobblestone blocks)

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place any blocks at X=247 or beyond (Worker2's area)
- Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks
- Do NOT move to another location
- Worker2 is simultaneously building the east foundation from X=247 to X=252

MATERIALS NEEDED: 40 cobblestone

When complete, the west foundation will connect seamlessly with Worker2's east foundation at the X=246/247 boundary.
constraints: Do NOT place blocks at or beyond X=247
Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks
Assume Worker2 is building east foundation simultaneously
Use cobblestone for foundation

Worker1.subtask: Build the west roof slope using oak_stairs. Slope from west edge (X=242) upward toward the center ridge at X=247. The roof slopes up from Y=-55 at X=242 to Y=-53 at X=247.
Worker1.objective: Build the west half of the house
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1, positioned at X=244, Y=-55, Z=-498. Do NOT move or navigate. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 3 of 4: ROOF (West Slope)

Your task: Build the west roof slope using oak_stairs, sloping TOWARD the center ridge at X=247.

ROOF RIDGE LOCATION: X=247, Y=-53 (this is where your roof meets Worker2's roof)

COORDINATES:
- X range: 242 to 246
- Z range: -502 to -495 (full depth of house)
- Y range: -55 to -53 (sloping upward toward ridge)

BUILD INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Row at X=242: Place oak_stairs at Y=-55, facing EAST, from Z=-502 to Z=-495
2. Row at X=243: Place oak_stairs at Y=-55, facing EAST, from Z=-502 to Z=-495
3. Row at X=244: Place oak_stairs at Y=-54, facing EAST, from Z=-502 to Z=-495
4. Row at X=245: Place oak_stairs at Y=-54, facing EAST, from Z=-502 to Z=-495
5. Row at X=246: Place oak_stairs at Y=-53, facing EAST, from Z=-502 to Z=-495

ALL stairs must face EAST (toward the ridge at X=247).

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place any blocks at X=247 (Worker2 places ridge blocks)
- Do NOT create your own ridge - slope TOWARD X=247
- Do NOT break walls below
- Worker2 is building east slope simultaneously, meeting at X=247

MATERIALS NEEDED: 40 oak_stairs

Your west slope will meet Worker2's east slope at X=247 to form ONE continuous roof peak.
constraints: Do NOT place blocks at or beyond X=247
Roof MUST slope TOWARD center ridge at X=247
Do NOT create a separate ridge on your side
Use oak_stairs facing EAST (toward ridge)
Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks

4. Row at X=250: Place oak_stairs at Y=-54, facing WEST, from Z=-502 to Z=-495

6. Row at X=252: Place oak_stairs at Y=-55, facing WEST, from Z=-502 to Z=-495

Ridge uses oak_planks. All stairs face WEST (toward ridge).

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place any blocks at X=246 or below
- Ridge at X=247 MUST align with Worker1's west slope
- Do NOT break walls below

MATERIALS NEEDED: 8 oak_planks (ridge) + 40 oak_stairs
